description: The plot illustrates training loss as a function of iteration for multiple model variants, showing several loss curves over the same training run. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 140,000 with regularly spaced tick labels every 20,000 iterations. The y-axis is labeled “Loss,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels at 0.1 intervals. A light purple solid line (with a faint shaded band around it) starts near about 3.4 at iteration 0, drops steeply within the first several thousand iterations to around the mid‑2.6 range, and then gradually decreases to roughly 2.46–2.48 by 140,000 iterations. A blue solid line labeled “StrmLLM (n=64)” begins near about 3.4, falls quickly to around ~2.8 by roughly 20,000 iterations, and then declines slowly to about 2.61–2.62 at 140,000 iterations. An orange solid line labeled “SepLLM (n=64)” starts near ~3.4, drops rapidly to around ~2.7 by about 20,000 iterations, and then trends downward to approximately 2.52–2.53 by 140,000 iterations. A green solid line labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H)” follows a similar shape, beginning near ~3.4, reaching roughly ~2.68–2.70 around 20,000 iterations, and ending near about 2.51–2.52 at 140,000 iterations. A red solid line labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” starts near ~3.4, decreases to around ~2.66–2.68 by about 20,000 iterations, and continues down to roughly 2.49–2.50 at 140,000 iterations. A dark blue solid line labeled “SepLLM (n=128)” begins near ~3.4, drops to around ~2.65–2.67 by about 20,000 iterations, and then gradually decreases to about 2.48–2.49 by 140,000 iterations; all series show small fluctuations around their main trajectories, with semi-transparent bands indicating variability around each curve.
